scope: 356 dated COVID/2022 cases, eight instruments, identical frozen market tape and dated macro-news scores.
No external language-model generation in this reproducible replay; compares deterministic production paths and calibration defaults.
Each source package runs in an isolated process with empty calibration state; no live state or provider keys affect comparison.
Matched-input variants share quant snapshots; full upstream variant recomputes its own features from only past bars.
Same next-open entry, five-session maximum hold, stops with adverse gaps, dividends, 3% assumed annual short borrow and 30-bps round-trip costs.
No leverage, same starting capital and sleeve accounting. Zero-exposure cases do not count as wins.
These are period returns, not annualized; not comparable to the separate six-year ETF policy.
2R target is a prespecified upstream execution idea, not fitted on these outcomes.
